chapter: Advice to youth and the art of drumming
title: The secret of big band drumming
summary: He explains that a big band drummer fills holes, keeps the band together as its general, and can be soft as cotton or flow; Butch Miles came from Mel Torme.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: See, any drummer is not going to do it, though, see. It's got to be that certain -- it's a combination of things. I guess we could name four or five drummers that are playing in four or five different bands and the different bands have different styles. But they fit that

particular combination. So -- and -- but they've all got to have some type of rhythm. They can't be jumping around on the instrument, and then running all over the instrument. See, it's just not effective. It's not effective.

Well, is there, in your opinion, and of course, you're one of the most experienced big band drummers, is there a secret to big band drumming? Do you play on top of the beat, behind the beat? I've heard guys say both ways. But what is big band drumming and how does it differ from combo drumming, in your opinion?

Well, big band drumming, I mean, with the big bands, see, you've got different sections. You've got your brass section, your trumpets, your trombones and then you've got your reed section there, you've got your rhythm section and all that. Somewhere over this whole thing, you have got to fit in there, you've got to fill up holes. But you've got to know when to fill those holes. Then you've still got to carry that beat, carry that -- make the band move, whereas with the small combination, you're playing very light, maybe a lot of brushes and a lot of things like that. Brushes are very effective, only it's limited in a big band, because the main thing of it is, you have to keep that band together. And then, this is the -- that's the most important thing, and this is a function of a drummer in a big band. And then, when you can get one that's able to fill up

the holes and look good and do this, then he's very flashy and then he looks good in the group, but yet he's doing -- Butch does that, Butch Miles, with Basie, he does that. He looks real good, but -- I think when he first joined the band and from the time he joined the band up until this time, I think he's had a lot of instructions and a lot of tips and different things from the guys in the band and all of that, as to how he supposed to play in the band.
See, he joined them from Mel Torme and this is where he come from when --

Yeah, he had been with Mel Torme and this is where they got him from. And, see, usually they play with trios and things like that. So this is the secret of that, the band, the big band drummer. He's got to take command. He's the general, really, he's the general. And he can be soft as cotton, playing soft as cotton -- what did they use to say, he's so soft you could hear a chinch piss on a cotton.
But then the next minute, he flows, and this is really what makes a big band drummer.
